event.name: hackathon
event.goal: bring together a small group of skilled crypto hackers to build or compete collaboratively
event.desired_attendees: good hackers with great involvement in the community, experience working at Meta
success_metrics: 20+ high-fit attendees aligned with the theme

audience_icp.name: meta_crypto_engineer
audience_icp.description: A software engineer with direct Meta/Facebook experience who has since pivoted into crypto protocol or dApp development.

audience_icp.name: protocol_hacker
audience_icp.description: A hands-on builder who has shipped or contributed to a crypto protocol, L1/L2, or DeFi primitive with verifiable open-source work.

audience_icp.name: crypto_open_source_contributor
audience_icp.description: An active GitHub contributor to well-known crypto repositories with a track record of PRs merged into major ecosystems.

audience_icp.name: zk_specialist
audience_icp.description: A developer deeply focused on zero-knowledge cryptography, building circuits, proving systems, or zkEVM components.

audience_icp.name: community_lead_hacker
audience_icp.description: A well-connected individual who organizes or co-organizes crypto developer communities, ETHGlobal events, or protocol DAOs while remaining a practicing builder.

audience_icp.name: defi_smart_contract_dev
audience_icp.description: A battle-tested smart contract developer who has deployed and audited DeFi protocols handling real funds.

audience_icp.name: crypto_infra_engineer
audience_icp.description: An engineer specializing in blockchain infrastructure — nodes, indexers, RPC layers, or cross-chain bridges — with a systems programming background.

audience_icp.name: hackathon_veteran_winner
audience_icp.description: A repeat hackathon participant with demonstrated prize wins or notable project launches originating from hack events.

avoid_personas.name: non_technical_crypto_marketer
avoid_personas.description: Community managers or marketers with no coding background dilute the builder-to-builder dynamic of a 5-person technical hackathon.

avoid_personas.name: investor_or_vc
avoid_personas.description: VCs or angels attending to scout rather than build reduce hacking output and shift room dynamics away from collaboration.

avoid_personas.name: blockchain_buzzword_generalist
avoid_personas.description: Individuals who claim broad crypto knowledge but lack verifiable technical output or specific protocol depth will slow a high-skill small group.

avoid_personas.name: purely_web2_engineer
avoid_personas.description: Skilled engineers with no crypto exposure would require onboarding time that is incompatible with a focused small-group crypto hackathon.

avoid_personas.name: nft_trader_hobbyist
avoid_personas.description: NFT collectors or traders without engineering skills add no technical value and misunderstand the collaborative build format.

items: AI agent founders building production agent systems
AI infra / devtools engineers shipping agent frameworks
Applied AI leads at Series A-C startups
Active GitHub contributors to popular agent / LLM tooling repos
High-signal community organizers in AI infra space

items.channel: Meta/Novi/Diem alumni networks on LinkedIn filtered by current crypto role
ETHGlobal alumni and finalist directories from recent hackathons
Protocol Guild membership list and contributor rosters
Ethereum Magicians forum and EIP authorship credits
GitHub search: contributors to major Ethereum/Solana/ZK repos with Meta employment history
Crypto Twitter/Farcaster accounts known for technical threads with Meta background mentions
Devcon and ETHDenver speaker and workshop facilitator lists
Warm intros from existing attendees or crypto VC technical networks
ZK-focused Telegram and Discord communities (ZK Hack, Aztec Discord, StarkNet Discord)
Alumni groups for Meta engineering orgs on LinkedIn

items: Warm intros and known builders go to top of queue.
Founders/engineers actively building in-theme rank higher than investors.
If two prospects tie on fit, prefer the one with stronger contribution signal (writing, OSS, talks).
Cap any single company to ~3 attendees to keep room diverse.
Reject anyone matching avoid personas regardless of company prestige.

scoring_rubric.notes: Rubric heavily rewards the rare Meta-plus-crypto overlap and verifiable technical depth, with steep penalties for non-builders given the 5-person room has zero slack for mismatched attendees.

room_balance.summary: Top 5 prospects: gaps in none; overrepresented: meta_crypto_engineer.

notes: Audience designer status: ok. Personas: 8; avoid: 5.

prospects.name: Avery Ching
prospects.source: web_search: aptoslabs.com/team; mccormick.northwestern.edu; koreatimes.co.kr interview Oct 2025
prospects.why_relevant: Matches ICP persona 'meta_crypto_engineer'. Score breakdown: persona_match:meta_crypto_engineer(+80), founder_or_lead_signal(+8).
prospects.notes: Spent over a decade at Meta as tech lead of the crypto platform, leading all aspects of the Diem blockchain and Novi wallet infrastructure; co-founded Aptos Labs in 2021 to build a Move-based L1 blockchain, raising $400M+ and shipping mainnet in 2022. Deep distributed systems background with a PhD from Northwestern.

prospects.name: Sam Blackshear
prospects.source: web_search: github.com/sblackshear; theblock.co profile; cointelegraph.com Move language feature Jan 2024
prospects.why_relevant: Matches ICP persona 'crypto_open_source_contributor'. Score breakdown: persona_match:crypto_open_source_contributor(+64), founder_or_lead_signal(+8), github_or_writing_signal(+6).
prospects.notes: Created the Move smart contract language at Meta (as Principal Engineer on the Libra/Diem platform), which now powers both Sui and Aptos; active open-source contributor on GitHub (sblackshear), architecting Sui's smart contract infrastructure and Walrus Protocol at Mysten Labs.

prospects.name: Kostas Kryptos Chalkias
prospects.source: web_search: iq.wiki/wiki/kostas-chalkias; esat.kuleuven.be speaker bio; blog.sui.io interview Jun 2023
prospects.why_relevant: Matches ICP persona 'zk_specialist'. Score breakdown: persona_match:zk_specialist(+64), founder_or_lead_signal(+8).
prospects.notes: Led Meta's cryptography team for the Diem/Libra project and WhatsApp security; main contributor to zkLogin OAuth crypto authentication, HashWires range proofs, and Winterfell (first open-source STARK prover); holds a PhD in identity-based cryptography and has 50+ scientific publications on zero-knowledge proofs and post-quantum signatures.

prospects.name: George Danezis
prospects.why_relevant: Matches ICP persona 'protocol_hacker'. Score breakdown: persona_match:protocol_hacker(+72), founder_or_lead_signal(+8).
prospects.notes: Former Facebook Research Scientist (Novi/Diem team) who co-founded Chainspace (acquired by Facebook) before co-founding Mysten Labs; co-designed the Sui smart contract platform and the Narwhal/Tusk/Mysticeti DAG-based consensus protocols; Professor of Security & Privacy Engineering at UCL with 100+ peer-reviewed papers on Byzantine fault-tolerant systems and distributed ledger security.

prospects.name: Evan Cheng
prospects.source: web_search: coindesk.com 'Architect of Sui's Object-Oriented Revolution' Dec 2024; blockworks.co speaker profile; iq.wiki/wiki/evan-cheng
prospects.why_relevant: Matches ICP persona 'meta_crypto_engineer'. Score breakdown: persona_match:meta_crypto_engineer(+80), founder_or_lead_signal(+8).
prospects.notes: Led Novi Research & Development and served as Engineering Director of Calibra/Blockchain at Meta (Facebook), building the Move language and Diem platform; prior decade at Apple as a senior LLVM compiler engineer (2012 ACM Software System Award); co-founded Mysten Labs and shipped the Sui L1 blockchain to $1.5B+ TVL.

prospects.name: Adeniyi Abiodun
prospects.why_relevant: Matches ICP persona 'community_lead_hacker'. Score breakdown: persona_match:community_lead_hacker(+56), founder_or_lead_signal(+8).
prospects.notes: Established the Novi Crypto Platform team at Meta and led crypto infrastructure product development; co-founded one of the first large-scale Bitcoin mining companies (CloudHashing/PeerNova) and held blockchain product roles at Oracle and VMware before co-founding Mysten Labs; active community builder promoting Web3 developer adoption in Africa and globally.

prospects.name: Riyaz Faizullabhoy
prospects.source: web_search: techcrunch.com 'Former a16z execs launch Bastion' Sep 2023; cnbc.com Oct 2021; a16zcrypto.com announcement
prospects.why_relevant: Matches ICP persona 'crypto_infra_engineer'. Score breakdown: persona_match:crypto_infra_engineer(+48), founder_or_lead_signal(+8).
prospects.notes: Co-built the crypto custody infrastructure for Facebook's Novi wallet (formerly Calibra) as a senior security/blockchain infrastructure engineer; subsequently served as CTO of a16z Crypto advising portfolio protocols on security architecture; co-founded Bastion ($25M seed) to build web3 enterprise infrastructure—deep background in key management, secure enclaves, and distributed custody systems.

prospects.name: Nassim Eddequiouaq
prospects.source: web_search: techcrunch.com 'Former a16z execs launch Bastion' Sep 2023; coindesk.com Oct 2021; a16zcrypto.com announcement
prospects.why_relevant: Matches ICP persona 'defi_smart_contract_dev'. Score breakdown: persona_match:defi_smart_contract_dev(+56), founder_or_lead_signal(+8).
prospects.notes: Co-created the crypto custody and smart contract infrastructure for Facebook's Novi digital wallet; served as CISO of a16z Crypto auditing and advising DeFi protocol security across the firm's portfolio; co-founded Bastion to build secure web3 infrastructure for enterprise brands, with deep expertise in blockchain security, key management, and smart contract auditing.
